title: Timer retries preserve the original practice, queue, resume and attendance intent

source.ref: Independent UX audit UXJ-04 and integration audit INT-08, rechecked 2026-11-04.

detail: Mindless load failures previously discarded the requested practice, movement mode, queue leg and resume context; Try again called the generic open defaults. The local source candidate saves and replays its normalized loading request, retaining close/stale-load controls. Be Still history retry now retains the original attended flag alongside seconds, start, practice and mode; attended=false retries must not become attended=true. Movement already retained its options and is unchanged. Acceptance: returned/rejected data-load failures retry the original practice/resume; failure on the second queue leg retries that leg and advances once; persisted movement crash recovery remains intact; partial Be Still finish retries preserve attended=false; no reward, duration, WAM or server-action semantics are changed. Daniel specifically approved the exact four-test Mindless regression review patch, now applied. Remains open pending integrated-head required CI/preview and appropriate browser/production verification.

verify.evidence: On isolated base2692ad9, 79 tests in nine focused suites passed, including all four specifically approved provider retry regressions. Focused lint and whitespace checks passed. Temporary bounded proof also executed the actual Be Still saved-argument/replay source seams and preserved attended=false. Pristine-base negative control reproduced four defects and retained one positive control. No real session completion or production mutation was performed. Full TypeScript had no verdict and was stopped; not claimed green. Closed on the owner's ruling, 2026-11-09 19:17Z. Asked how to close the shipped-pending-check rows, Daniel answered "b": close them without a production check. Any code for it that merged keeps its unit pins in CI. No production look was taken.
